headlines.description: — Jose Trevino lined a two-run single to right field with the bases loaded in the sixth inning and the Cincinnati Reds rallied for a 6-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jose Trevino's 2-run single in 6th inning propels Reds to 6-4 win over Cubs

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Rookie shortstop Konnor Griffin had four hits, Brandon Lowe hit his 32nd homer and the Pittsburgh Pirates surged past the Kansas City Royals 8-5 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Konnor Griffin has 4 hits as the Pirates rally past the Royals to reach .500

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio hit a three-run homer, Sal Frelick singled in the go-ahead run in the 10th inning and the surging Milwaukee Brewers beat the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chourio's homer and Frelick's RBI single in 10th carry Brewers past Orioles 6-5

headlines.description: — José Ramírez and rookie Travis Bazzana homered and Joey Cantillo pitched six scoreless innings as the Cleveland Guardians rallied to beat the Athletics 5-3 on Friday night and moved one game ahead of Chicago in the AL Central.
headlines.shortLinkText: José Ramírez homers, reaches 1,000 RBIs as Guardians down A's 5-3, move into first alone in Central

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Roman Anthony homered and drove in three runs and the Boston Red Sox took a big step toward clinching an American League playoff spot with a 4-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox beat Rays 4-2 to close in on playoff spot

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Juan Soto hit a three-run homer and the New York Mets kept the Philadelphia Phillies from gaining ground in the National League wild-card race with a 6-3 victory Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Juan Soto's homer leads Mets to 6-3 win that keeps Phillies from taking over top NL wild-card spot

events.name: Detroit Tigers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Hao-Yu Lee and Riley Greene each hit a two-run homer in a five-run eighth inning as the Detroit Tigers rallied from six down to beat the Chicago White Sox 11-8 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox blow 6-run lead and fall out of 1st place in AL Central with 11-8 loss to Tigers

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Corey Seager had an RBI double in a four-run second inning fueled by a throwing error, and the Texas Rangers beat the Toronto Blue Jays 7-1 on Friday night in the opener of a series matching AL playoff chasers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Corey Seager's RBI double helps Rangers beat sloppy Blue Jays 7-1 and close gap in playoff race

headlines.description: — Michael Harris II, Ronald Acuña Jr. and Matt Olson each hit a two-run homer as the Atlanta Braves clinched a playoff berth with a 6-2 victory over the Houston Astros on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves punch playoff ticket as Harris, Acuña and Olson launch 2-run homers in 6-2 win over Astros

headlines.description: — Lazaro Montes led off the ninth inning with a 426-foot home run and the Seattle Mariners beat the Colorado Rockies 5-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montes hits leadoff homer in the 9th to lift the Mariners over the Rockies, 5-4

events.name: Washington Nationals at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — CJ Abrams became the 52nd player to join the 30-30 club, Cade Cavalli threw his 200th strikeout of the year, and the Washington Nationals took down the St. Louis Cardinals 9-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: CJ Abrams joins 30-30 club as Nationals rout Cardinals 9-1

events.name: Minnesota Twins at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Connor Prielipp allowed two hits in a season-high seven innings and fellow rookie Walker Jenkins homered to lead the Minnesota Twins to a 3-0 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Prielipp and Walker Jenkins lead Twins to 3-0 victory over Angels

events.name: Miami Marlins at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Ty France hit a three-run homer to cap a six-run rally in the fifth inning and the San Diego Padres beat the Miami Marlins 8-2 on Friday night to pull into a tie with Philadelphia and Chicago for the top National League wild card.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ty France's 3-run homer helps Padres to 8-2 win over Marlins and into tie for top NL wild-card spot

events.name: New York Yankees at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Ben Rice hit his 39th homer of the season, Gerrit Cole became the winningest No. 1 overall draft pick and the New York Yankees used a five-run first inning to take control early and beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 9-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ben Rice hits 39th homer, Cole becomes winningest No. 1 draft pick as Yanks cruise past D-backs 9-2

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Mookie Betts homered twice and the Los Angeles Dodgers went deep four times in the eighth inning of an 8-2 victory over the San Francisco Giants on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mookie Betts homers twice and Dodgers go back-to-back twice in 8th inning of 8-2 win over Giants
